description: Full platform audit. Run tsc --noEmit, identify ALL TypeScript errors across the platform. Fix any errors introduced by FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. Report pre-existing errors (errors that existed before this task) separately in the findings field. Audit the 7 key files for broken imports, logic bugs, and runtime issues. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 being complete.
steps: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in c:\Users\Administrator\Nursefiti3. Capture the full output.

Categorise each error: (a) new — introduced by FEAT-001 or FEAT-002, (b) pre-existing — was already there before this task. Fix ALL errors in category (a). Document category (b) in findings without fixing them (they are pre-existing and out of scope unless trivial).

Audit app/(student)/dashboard/page.tsx: verify the banner logic (exam date comparison) is correct; verify that the HeroBanner still receives examDate even when the date is past (it should — the countdown will show 0 but that's expected); verify no import is broken.
Audit app/(student)/settings/page.tsx: verify the exam date validation (must be in the future) still works and does not conflict with the new banner logic.
Audit app/(admin)/admin/students/page.tsx: verify existing modals and actions still function; verify the new ExpiredActiveStudent interface and fetch logic compile cleanly.

Audit app/(admin)/admin/scholarships/[campaignId]/ClientManager.tsx: check for any TypeScript errors on the supabase calls (the file uses 'supabase as any' casts throughout — look for any non-cast calls that could error); verify the availableFunds calculation is correct.
Audit app/(admin)/admin/scholarships/[campaignId]/page.tsx: verify the server component fetches and passes premiumPrice correctly.
Audit app/sponsor/[slug]/page.tsx: verify all imports (BarChart etc. from recharts) are used and resolve; verify the security check logic for is_public is correct.

Audit app/scholarships/[slug]/apply/page.tsx: verify the ApplyForm import resolves (app/scholarships/[slug]/apply/ApplyForm.tsx must exist); if it does not exist, create a stub that satisfies the TypeScript import.
Audit app/(admin)/admin/students/page.tsx (again, final check): confirm the 'Edit Exam Date' button in the new expired section calls openExamModal with a Student-compatible object.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` a final time. All new errors must be zero. Record final output in findings.
acceptance_criteria: npx tsc --noEmit completes with zero errors introduced by FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
All 7 audited files import cleanly with no broken import paths.
Pre-existing errors are documented in findings without being introduced or worsened.
No functionality regressions — existing features (plan modal, lock/unlock, exam date modal, scholarship banner, community banner, audit banner) remain intact.
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in c:\Users\Administrator\Nursefiti3. Zero errors that were not present before this task.
